status: frozen before training; research-only; no activation
coordinates: Preserve greedy CTC Start/End. Reject End*inputWidth > validWidth*timeSteps; sourceX=Crop.X+step*inputWidth/(timeSteps*validWidth)*Crop.Width, sourceY/height=Crop.Y/height. No clamping or fabrication.
model: 3 small Conv-BN-SiLU blocks, strides(2,2),(2,1),(1,2), channels16/32/64; flatten vertical16 positions; linear96; one BiLSTM64; CTC97 and independent sigmoid reject head

final.qualification: Standalone ASCII grid pages do not establish production timetable/header/role qualification; parent native full-document integration required.

fontConsumption: Train fonts previously consumed. Kosugi and SawarabiMincho had prior source-only PDF extraction use, never recognizer input. SawarabiGothic never rendered/inferred. Final recognizer fonts reserved by parent; download/license inspection only before checkpoint selection.
positiveBalance: Equal arbitrary alphanumeric codes, arbitrary printable ASCII punctuation/internal spaces, I/l/1/O/0-rich arbitrary codes, natural generic non-school English lines with random code suffix. All printable characters covered; no leading/trailing whitespace labels.
rendering: 16..34 logical px, source density2 or4 (actual font32..136px), shared whole-line baseline/ascent/descent and margins; black/navy/gray/green;15% light blur,15% JPEG; no glyph-tight resizing; low-density aliases only separate contradiction probes;50% full canvas and50% whole-line vertical ink crop with2..12 logical px margins, all glyphs share baseline/resize and original ink preserved;clipped controls remove20..40% of actual ink height
negativeBalance: Equal CJK-only/mixed lines, top/bottom clipping, multiline, visibly non-ASCII/noise. Negative labels are UNK/reject, never reconstructed full missing text. Blanks are separate controls, not proof of empty source.
contradictionProbe: Independent Latin/Cyrillic or valid/removed-stroke aliases. Pixel-identical known/unknown or complete/damaged inputs cannot be distinguished by crop-only OCR; report separately and require original-source proof, never claim universal rejection.
selection: Highest harmonic mean of positive exact fraction and negative rejected fraction; tie positive exact count, lower CER, earliest epoch. One checkpoint hash fixed before final rendering; final never selects, repairs or changes threshold.
acceptance: No UNK, nonempty text, all character minconfidence>=0.8, rejectProbability<=0.01, all CTC intervals supported. Uncalibrated model policy is experimental, requires original ink/cell/complete-source/validator proof and <=3 actual body corrections per document.
portability: Standard ONNX x -> probabilities/rejectProbability, dictionary/preprocessing/source intervals/provenance; optional CoreML on Linux conversion only, no Apple inference qualification. No iOS edits.
dataProhibition: No real school subjects/names/rooms/originals. All previous literal strings excluded. No old pixels or model-corrected text as targets. No oracle output repair, inference candidate selection, manually supplied document headers or structure. No worker commit/push.
resourceLimit: CPU2threads, own process target<4GiB, max address space12GiB; no speed claims under concurrent work
